subject: How to get install() in devtools to look for dependencies in several .libPaths

messages.author: 3f1b57241ff195d2
messages.subject: How to get install() in devtools to look for dependencies in several .libPaths
parts:
Hi

Is it possible to make install() look for dependencies in other .libPaths() directories before deciding to install them?

My .libPaths() setup is as follows: The first directory-path in .libPaths() is where I install my own packages and packages not on CRAN., while the second directory-path contains a lot of common packages from CRAN.

My own package depends on quite a few other packages. I wish to install it in the first directory-path in .libPath(), but I do NOT want to re-install packages which I already have installed in the second directory-path in libPaths().

When running R CMD INSTALL package from the command line, only packages not found in the second (or first) directory-path are installed (in the first one). This is the desired behavior. When running devtools install() or install_github all packages which are not found in the first directory-path are installed even if they are already installed in the second one. Look and testing various input arguments does not seem to fix this behavior.

Does anyone know whether it is possible to accomplish the command line behavior with devtools-install?
